claims: OS Terrain 50 is a lower-resolution bare-earth DTM
Grid post spacing is 50 metres
Contours use 10 metre intervals
Grid and contours derive from the same source data
ASCII GML and shapefile supplies use 10km tiles
Tile names use the south-west National Grid reference
A full Great Britain tiled supply contains 2858 tiles
Whole-tile refresh is used instead of feature change-only updates
ASCII tiles contain 200 columns and 200 rows
Each pixel is 50 metres by 50 metres
Rows are read west to east
Successive rows progress south from the north-west origin
Grid heights are calculated at pixel centres
Grid heights are supplied to the nearest 0.1 metre
GML supplies location grid spacing and vertical reference metadata
The projection file supplies the spatial reference system
ContourLine uses line geometry
SpotHeight uses point geometry
LandWaterBoundary uses line geometry
Spot-height propertyValue represents height above Newlyn or another British datum
GML feature identifiers include product tile and sequence
Geometry identifiers add a geom suffix
Identifiers are unique within a product release
GML geometry CRS is expressed as EPSG:27700
Contours are available in GML shapefile GeoPackage and MBTiles
GeoPackage contours are supplied as a national file
Per-tile XML metadata follows GEMINI
OS Terrain 50 grid has been verified at 4m RMSE
A TQ29 tile contract does not prove the candidate cell
Exact TQ29 product bytes and release identity are required
Exact cell coordinates and values are required for numeric promotion
Absent authoritative tile bytes or values remain blocked
